rapport_notes: Functional and polite, flexible on rescheduling to a preferred morning slot, but no particular warmth-building moments.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concern raised; the customer's questions (hourly rate, furniture size, employee status) were factual/process questions answered directly.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: whatever time is accumulated during move day, that's only what you pay for

top_strength: Efficient, accurate quoting and flexible on rescheduling to accommodate her preferred morning arrival time, resulting in a booking.
coaching_note: Skipped the differentiators pitch almost entirely -- no damage coverage ($2,000 evaluation) and no on-time guarantee were ever mentioned; worth running the full differentiator script even on a fast, price-focused caller.
